annotations.title: Find care after a hospital stay near a ZIP code

description: The tool lists care Medicare covers after a hospital stay near a five-digit ZIP code. It lists nursing homes and rehabilitation or long-term care hospitals with an address in ZIP codes sharing the first three digits. It lists home health agencies and hospices that list the ZIP in Medicare's files. It returns up to 5 per setting with Medicare's own figures and states each list's order. It never ranks one setting against another.

settings.description: Optional settings to list: nursing_homes, rehab_hospitals, home_health, hospice.

name: find_care_after_hospital
